objects.description: During the [SolarWinds Compromise](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0024), [APT29](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0016) renamed software and DLLs with legitimate names to appear benign.(Citation: Volexity SolarWinds)(Citation: Microsoft Analyzing Solorigate Dec 2020)
objects.description_fa: در طول [SolarWinds Compromise](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0024)، [APT29](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0016) نام نرم‌افزارها و DLL‌هایی با نام‌های قانونی را تغییر داد تا بی‌خطر به نظر برسند.(Citation: Volexity SolarWinds)[[[CTI_PRESERVE_3]ER] (Citation: Microsoft Analyzing Solorigate Dec 2020)
